# Task P0-10: Dockerfile, s6-overlay init and compose

**Phase:** 0 · **Depends on:** P0-08, P0-09 · **Suggested tier:** cheap worker (orchestrator builds and verifies on the test host) · **Estimated size:** M

## Goal
One multi-arch image (`linux/amd64`, `linux/arm64`) that runs Compilarr on port 1077 with the React UI, the bundled slskd under `/opt/slskd`, static `ffmpeg`/`ffprobe`, `fpcalc` and Deno, using s6-overlay with hotio/LinuxServer-style `PUID`/`PGID`/`UMASK`/`TZ`, a `HEALTHCHECK` on `/ping`, and a single-service `docker/docker-compose.yml`. You cannot run Docker in your environment: write the files carefully, syntax-check the shell scripts, and the orchestrator builds and tests the image.

## Deliverables
- `docker/Dockerfile` (build context = repo root), BuildKit syntax, stages:
  1. `frontend` (`--platform=$BUILDPLATFORM`): copy `frontend/package.json` + `package-lock.json`, `npm ci`, copy the rest of `frontend/` and `docs/api/openapi.json`, `npm run build` (it writes to `../src/Compilarr.Api/wwwroot`, so keep the repo-relative layout under `/src`).
  2. `build` (`--platform=$BUILDPLATFORM`, sdk image): copy `global.json`, `Directory.*.props`, `Compilarr.sln`, the `src/**/*.csproj` files, `dotnet restore src/Compilarr.Api/Compilarr.Api.csproj -a $TARGETARCH`, copy `src/`, copy the frontend output into `src/Compilarr.Api/wwwroot`, `dotnet publish src/Compilarr.Api/Compilarr.Api.csproj -c Release -a $TARGETARCH --no-self-contained -o /app -p:Version=$VERSION` (`ARG VERSION=0.0.0-dev`). Framework-dependent publish on the aspnet runtime image (see Constraints).
  3. `downloads` (runs on the target platform so `uname`/arch mapping is simple, or map `TARGETARCH` → `x86_64|aarch64` / `x64|arm64` explicitly): download + `sha256sum -c` every pinned artifact above; unpack s6-overlay tarballs into `/s6`, Deno into `/tools/deno`, fpcalc into `/tools/fpcalc`; run `scripts/fetch-slskd.sh 0.26.0 <x64|arm64> /opt/slskd`.
  4. `runtime` (aspnet noble): `apt-get install --no-install-recommends` `tzdata xz-utils wget ca-certificates` (and clean lists); extract s6-overlay into `/`; copy `/app`, `/opt/slskd`, `ffmpeg`/`ffprobe`/`deno`/`fpcalc` into `/usr/local/bin`; create user/group `compilarr` (uid/gid 1000, home `/config`, no login shell); `COPY docker/root/ /`; `ENV COMPILARR_CONFIG_DIR=/config PUID=1000 PGID=1000 UMASK=002 TZ=Etc/UTC S6_BEHAVIOUR_IF_STAGE2_FAILS=2 S6_CMD_WAIT_FOR_SERVICES_MAXTIME=0 DOTNET_BUNDLE_EXTRACT_BASE_DIR=/config/slskd/.net`; `VOLUME /config /data`; `EXPOSE 1077 50300`; `HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=5s --start-period=60s CMD wget -q --spider http://localhost:1077/ping || exit 1`; `ENTRYPOINT ["/init"]`. OCI labels (`org.opencontainers.image.source=https://github.com/wulfftech/compilarr`, `licenses=GPL-3.0-only`, `version=$VERSION`).
- `docker/root/etc/s6-overlay/s6-rc.d/` (s6-rc v3 layout; every script `#!/command/with-contenv sh`, `set -eu`, LF endings, executable bit recorded with `git update-index --chmod=+x`):
  - `init-compilarr-user/` (`type` = `oneshot`, `up` = `/etc/s6-overlay/scripts/init-compilarr-user`): validates `PUID`/`PGID` are integers, `groupmod -o -g "$PGID" compilarr`, `usermod -o -u "$PUID" compilarr`, `mkdir -p /config /config/logs /config/slskd`, `chown compilarr:compilarr /config /config/logs /config/slskd` (not recursive over `/data`; recursive only over `/config/slskd` and `/config/logs`), prints the effective uid/gid.
  - `svc-compilarr/` (`type` = `longrun`, `run` script: `umask "${UMASK:-002}"`, `cd /app`, `exec s6-setuidgid compilarr dotnet /app/Compilarr.Api.dll`; `dependencies.d/init-compilarr-user` empty file).
  - `user/contents.d/init-compilarr-user` and `user/contents.d/svc-compilarr` (empty files).
  - The actual script bodies in `docker/root/etc/s6-overlay/scripts/`.
- `docker/docker-compose.yml`: single service `compilarr`, `build: { context: .., dockerfile: docker/Dockerfile }`, `image: ghcr.io/wulfftech/compilarr:develop`, `container_name: compilarr`, environment `PUID=1000`, `PGID=1000`, `UMASK=002`, `TZ=Etc/UTC`, volumes `./config:/config`, `./data:/data`, ports `1077:1077`, `50300:50300`, `restart: unless-stopped` (the image's HEALTHCHECK applies).
- `.dockerignore` at the repo root: `**/bin`, `**/obj`, `**/node_modules`, `.git`, `.worktrees`, `.worker`, `.env*`, `src/Compilarr.Api/wwwroot`, `frontend/dist`, `**/*.db`.
- `docs/architecture/DEPLOYMENT.md`: append a short "Image contents (Phase 0)" subsection to §9.2 listing the pinned versions above and the s6 services; keep the rest unchanged.

## Context to read first
- `docs/architecture/DEPLOYMENT.md` §9.1–9.2, `docs/architecture/CONFIG_EXAMPLES.md` (compose), `scripts/fetch-slskd.sh`, `src/Compilarr.Api/Compilarr.Api.csproj`, `frontend/package.json`, `frontend/vite.config.ts`

## Constraints
- **Framework-dependent publish** on `aspnet:10.0-noble`, not self-contained/trimmed: EF Core, SignalR and Quartz use reflection that trimming breaks, and the runtime image already carries .NET. (The orchestrator records this deviation from STACK.md §8.3.)
- The app runs as the `compilarr` user, never root; slskd is started by the app, so it inherits that user.
- Everything downloaded is checksum-verified; no `curl | sh`.
- Syntax-check every shell script with `sh -n` and paste the results. No other verification is possible for you.

## Acceptance criteria
1. `sh -n` passes for every script under `docker/root/etc/s6-overlay/scripts/` and `scripts/fetch-slskd.sh`.
2. Every pinned artifact in the table appears in the Dockerfile with its sha256.
3. (Orchestrator, on the test host) `docker build -f docker/Dockerfile .` succeeds; the container starts, `/ping` answers on 1077, `HEALTHCHECK` reports healthy; `docker exec` as the app user: `ffprobe -version`, `fpcalc -version`, `deno --version`, `/opt/slskd/slskd --version` run; a file created by the app under `/config` has the configured PUID/PGID; image size recorded.
